caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bedside cabinet with a rich, reddish-brown color and a wood grain pattern visible on all surfaces. The cabinet features a rectangular shape with rounded top corners at the back, rising above the otherwise flat top surface. There is a single drawer near the top, identified by two circular, metallic knobs, and below the drawer is a cabinet door with another round knob on the left and a visible hinge on the right. The legs are slender, tapering, and vertically fluted, with small metallic casters at the base of each leg. The cabinet stands against a plain, light beige background. The artist's name, "ULRICH FISCHER," is written in the lower left corner.
title: Washstand
